title: Kermit cult
description: A Minecraft mod pack for the Kermit Cult discord server and friends | QOL + Map Gen + Shaders + Textures
body: A chill Fabric modpack for me and my friends, packed with shaders, QoL tweaks, cool visuals, and fun features like voice chat, dynamic lighting, and 3D crops. Perfect for playing together on Discord with style and convenience.
